name: Batch Service Interface Example Module
description: Provide a simple form that kicks off an example batch job.
project_description: Hidden example submodule of Batch Service Interface. It ships one admin form (route batch_example.example_form at /batch_example/form) that asks for a message count and kicks off a batch which logs that many random quotes, demonstrating how to build a batch as a dependency-injected service by extending AbstractBatchService. Intended as reference code, not for production use.
